# Credence Lighting LLC

> Credence Lighting LLC is a Dubai-based lighting design, supply, and installation company. The site covers architectural, commercial, hospitality, residential, retail, entertainment, facade, automation, LED screen, stretch ceiling, and audio projects across the UAE and GCC. It also includes case studies, technical articles, FAQs, downloads, gallery, brands, and official contact details.

## Start here

- [About](https://credencelighting.com/about): Company overview, schema metadata, service model, location, and official contact details.
- [Products](https://credencelighting.com/products): Core product categories and their category pages.
- [Solutions](https://credencelighting.com/solutions): Industry landing pages for hospitality, residential, restaurant, retail, entertainment, office, audio, and facade lighting.
- [Projects](https://credencelighting.com/projects): Portfolio of completed work.
- [Blog](https://credencelighting.com/blog): Technical and educational articles on lighting design, controls, standards, buying guides, and project planning.
- [FAQ](https://credencelighting.com/faq): Common questions and answers about services and project support.
- [Downloads](https://credencelighting.com/downloads): PDF resources and company materials.
- [Gallery](https://credencelighting.com/gallery): Project imagery and installation inspiration.
- [Brands](https://credencelighting.com/brands): Client and brand references featured on the site.
- [Contact](https://credencelighting.com/contact): Official address, phone, email, hours, and inquiry form.

## Authority notes

- The site publishes structured data on key pages.
- Project detail pages use `CreativeWork` schema.
- The Home page includes `WebSite`, `Organization`, and `LocalBusiness` schema; the About page includes `Organization` schema; the Contact page includes `LocalBusiness` schema.
- The About page states 10+ years of experience and founding date 2014.
- The Contact and About schemas list the official address in Dubai Investment Park 1 and area served as AE, SA, and BH.

## Terminology used on the site

- CRI: Color Rendering Index.
- UGR: Unified Glare Rating.
- HCL: Human Centric Lighting.
- BGM: Background Music.
- ESTIDAMA: Abu Dhabi sustainability framework.
- LEED: Green building certification.
- DALI, DMX, KNX, Crestron, Casambi: Lighting control and automation systems.

## Official business details

- Legal name: Credence Lighting LLC

- Email: info@credencelighting.com

- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 18:00
- Languages: English and Arabic
